tasks.title: NeoMud Three practical reset
tasks.description: Turn the current Three.js proof of concept into a server-backed game client architecture: Kotlin server authority, normalized client game state, renderer engine, scene registry, reusable components, generated asset pipeline, gameplay surfaces, and repeatable QA.

tasks.title: Keep Kotlin server as authoritative game spine
tasks.description: Document and preserve the boundary where /game WebSocket messages own auth, current room, movement legality, NPC/player presence, inventory, combat, dialogue, tutorials, and interactables. Renderer may cache and predict but must reconcile to server messages.

comments.body: Server authority boundary is implemented in the protocol adapter and documented in memory-bank/architecture.md; preserve as an invariant.

tasks.title: Extract normalized client game state and command router
tasks.description: Create a small state store and command router so UI, physical exits, minimap, hotkeys, and future interactions dispatch to server-backed commands or explicit offline fallback through one path.

tasks.title: Extract persistent Three render engine
tasks.description: Move renderer, scene, camera rig, lights, render loop, current room group disposal, resize, and debug hooks out of app.js without changing current play behavior.

tasks.title: Add scene registry and RoomRenderSpec layer
tasks.description: Normalize NeoMud room data plus server overlays into render specs, then resolve room ids/kinds to scene builders through a registry instead of hard-coded if/else branches.

comments.body: Added initial scene-registry.js so app.js resolves room scenes through one registry instead of hard-coded builders; RoomRenderSpec remains next.
Added initial TOWN_SQUARE_SPEC authoring layer with surfaces, chunk rings, landmarks, props, spawns, and exit triggers so future layout changes are spec edits instead of raw mesh surgery.
Town Square exits are now explicit RoomRenderSpec-style trigger volumes validated against the real room graph.

tasks.title: Build generated asset manifest and material manager
tasks.description: Centralize generated texture/cutout metadata, texture repeat scale, transparency mode, color space, caching, and intended component use.

comments.body: Added experiments/neomud-three/render-assets.js with generated asset manifest, texture cache, and temple/town material factories.

Added project asset manifest plus starter material registry/preload path. New townPlasterTimber and quieter townHorizonDay assets are project-local WebP outputs copied/converted from built-in imagegen.

Added project asset manifest plus starter material registry/preload path. New townPlasterTimber and quieter townHorizonDay assets are project-local WebP outputs copied/converted from built-in imagegen.

tasks.title: Create reusable Three component kit
tasks.description: Introduce reusable components for floors, walls, portals, arches, stained-glass windows, buildings, stalls, signs, lights, billboards, NPC markers, and in-world interactable affordances.

comments.body: Added components/scene-components.js and moved Town Square toward reusable boxes, ground planes, backdrops, gabled houses, stalls, portal frames, and lamps.

tasks.title: Make Temple of the Dawn the visual quality bar
tasks.description: Rebuild the cathedral on top of components with convincing scale, window framing, transparent stained glass, readable portal, altar, incense, warm lighting, and color patches on the marble floor.

tasks.title: Rebuild Town Square as a physical 3D place
tasks.description: Replace the placeholder flat-backdrop feel with streets, building rows, stalls, fountain, portals, NPC zones, lighting, and generated materials that use the original room image as reference rather than as the whole illusion.

comments.body: Upgraded Town Square footprint, spawn framing, environment background, roads, perimeter, civic rows, market stalls, lamps, portals, and NPC staging; still not final quality bar.

QA/design reset: current square still reads noisy and toy-scaled. Next bar is fewer, larger named landmarks tied to real room ids: Gate north, Market east, Temple south, Tavern/bar west. Use calm low-detail horizon and chunk-ring scenery rather than detailed pasted-room backdrops.

QA/design reset: current square still reads noisy and toy-scaled. Next bar is fewer, larger named landmarks tied to real room ids: Gate north, Market east, Temple south, Tavern/bar west. Use calm low-detail horizon and chunk-ring scenery rather than detailed pasted-room backdrops.

Wayfinding/readability pass: larger Gate/Market/Tavern/Temple landmarks, calmer surfaces, visible exit boards, threshold markers, central signpost, and QA score updated to 10/12 for readability/server sync/perf while architecture/art finish remains rough.

Architecture pass improved Town Square landmark massing and readability without adding generated assets. Still prototype-grade; next work should focus material hierarchy, label reduction, NPC/item integration, and stronger authored identity.

Town Square readability now depends less on floating labels: NPC labels are proximity/panel driven, signpost is out of central view, and NPCs have local staging. Still needs material/ground/facade art-direction work.
Material hierarchy pass separated field, roads, plaza, and thresholds. Next Town Square work should reduce the yellow/tan palette and improve facade/roof silhouettes.

Facade/palette pass shipped: central signpost removed, landmark boards carry navigation, surfaces cooled, tavern/market props added, lamps/dormers reduced. QA: offline smoke pass, server-backed pass, spec validation pass, headed Town Square 158 calls / 54,736 triangles.

Playable slice expanded: Town Square west exit now enters authored Rusty Tankard Tavern scene, then returns to Town Square through an east physical exit. Offline/server tests assert Barkeep Grom and round-trip movement.

tasks.title: Connect gameplay surfaces to 3D affordances
tasks.description: Map server messages for NPCs, room items, tutorials, dialogue, combat, inventory, locked exits, and interactables to in-world objects or focused DOM panels.

comments.body: Town Square now maps server/world NPC presence into in-world entities with proximity interaction and DOM detail panels. Room item marker support is in the renderer, but item-specific server action flow remains future work.

tasks.title: Run HTML-in-Canvas projection spike after components stabilize
tasks.description: Use real HTML for in-world boards/books/dialogue surfaces only after room components and hit testing are stable; keep accessibility and input alignment explicit.

tasks.title: Maintain repeatable QA gates
tasks.description: Keep node --check, offline smoke, server-backed guest/movement test, screenshot output, and manual Canary QA as required gates before pushes.

comments.body: QA note: offline Playwright smoke passes. Server-backed test can pass after restarting guest sessions, but the local server hit the Too many guest sessions state during this pass; this should be made deterministic before treating server QA as robust.
Added scripts/play-neomud-three.cjs for headed Chrome/Canary real-time playtesting, including optional drive-and-close route plus QA screenshots and render/server/player snapshots.
QA gates now include spec validation and server-backed physical trigger movement, not only debug requestMove.

Full QA run: spec validation passed, offline smoke passed, headed Canary drive captured QA screenshot, server-backed Temple -> Town Square -> Temple passed after clearing local guest-session saturation.
QA now covers entity metadata, Old Wren proximity interaction, dialogue panel content, server NPC entity resolution, and no failed sprite requests.

QA checkpoint for facade/palette pass: node --check changed modules, spec validation, git diff --check, offline smoke, headed Canary playtest, and server-backed Temple -> Town Square -> Temple test all passed. Local server required clearing stale guest sessions first.

Render budget gate shipped: tests now assert per-room render calls, triangles, textures, and geometries; headed playtest writes qa/latest/report.json. Geometry disposal on room/entity rebuild fixed retained geometry count in routed Town Square playtest from 498 to 222.

tasks.title: Increase movement speed and add jump
tasks.description: Make player locomotion feel more game-like: faster walk/run baseline, Space jump with gravity/landing, camera/player animation staying stable, and QA coverage through smoke plus headed playtest.

comments.body: Implemented faster walk/run tuning plus Space jump with gravity, landing state, air control, and debug player grounded/verticalVelocity fields. Offline smoke now asserts jump and landing.
Implemented faster walk/run, diagonal movement baseline, Space jump with gravity/landing, and smoke-test assertions.

tasks.title: Reorient Temple cathedral layout
tasks.description: Move altar to the south ceremonial end and make the town exit read as the opposite entry doorway. Update spawn/exit thresholds, altar lighting, incense, floor runes, and QA screenshots so the nave has coherent directionality.

comments.body: Reoriented Temple nave: town entry/exit remains north, spawn faces down the nave, altar/incense/light moved to the south ceremonial end, and floor rune moved away from the doorway.
Temple spawn moved deeper into the nave, north exit separated from spawn, south altar retained as the destination end, and screenshots/tests pass.

tasks.title: Upgrade player avatar visual quality
tasks.description: Replace the capsule placeholder feel with a more beautiful readable fantasy avatar: richer silhouette, cape/armor details, head/hair/shoulders, weapon proportions, contact shadow, and animation hooks.

comments.body: Rebuilt avatar from capsule pawn into a richer handcrafted fantasy adventurer: armor, trim, cape, hair, sword, contact shadow, and animation hooks for stride/jump.
Soldier probe rejected. Active avatar is now Xbot/Mixamo-style skinned rig with AnimationMixer idle/walk/run; still placeholder art and needs a proper NeoMud-authored skinned adventurer.

tasks.title: Fix Town Square fountain
tasks.description: Make the fountain read as a real plaza feature instead of broken geometry: stable basin, centered water disk, column/bowl proportions, gentle water motion, collision-safe placement, and visual QA.

comments.body: Rebuilt fountain as grouped plaza object with apron, basin, centered water disk, column, upper bowl, falling-water hint, and gentler animation/light.
Fountain rebuilt as grouped basin/column/top bowl/water feature and verified by offline/headed screenshots.

comments.body: Implemented deterministic procedural town surface materials, explicit plaza/stoop surfaces with borders, and verified offline/server/headed QA. Visual hierarchy is clearer, but palette remains too yellow and facades still need art-direction work.

tasks.title: Refine Town Square facades and palette

comments.body: Pass removes redundant central signpost, cools Town Square road/plaza/ground palette, adds restrained facade/roof props, reduces lamps/dormers, and keeps headed QA under budget at 158 draw calls / 54,736 triangles.

comments.body: Added neomud-three QA helper with render budgets, offline/server report files, headed playtest report.json, renderer memory stats, and geometry disposal on room/entity rebuild. QA passed: offline smoke, server-backed movement, headed Canary playtest, spec validation, diff check.
